title: Payment Terms Card for Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreements
content:
The payment terms of the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement are the same in every unit class except for the returned-payment fee.

## Terms identical in all six classes

| Term | Setting in every class |
|---|---|
| Payment smaller than the balance due while the rental is delinquent | accepted |
| Payment smaller than the balance due once a lien notice has been sent | not accepted |
| Redemption after a lien notice | requires the full balance, including lien fees |
| Order in which a payment is applied within one rental | oldest billing period first, and within a billing period its fees before its rent |
| Methods the care center can take over the phone | credit card, debit card, and a one-time debit from a bank account (ACH) |

## Returned-payment fee by class

| Unit class | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $35.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $35.00 |

The returned-payment fee is the class's fee charged when a payment is returned unpaid by the bank for insufficient funds or a closed account.

## Points of reading

- A partial payment is a payment smaller than the balance due. It is taken from a delinquent rental in every class and refused in every class once a lien notice has gone out.
- On a hypothetical rental with an unpaid administrative fee and unpaid rent in its first billing period and unpaid rent in its second, a payment reaches the first period's fee, then the first period's rent, then the second period's rent.
- The class's returned-payment fee is $35.00 for the Bluegate Premier Climate Suite and the Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault and $30.00 for the four other classes.
